comment: Occasional themed rounds, the way Terraria drops a Blood Moon or an invasion on you. An event overrides how many spawn, what spawns, how hard it hits and what it pays, and drags the arena to a biome that suits it. Only ordinary rounds roll one -- a boss round is already the event. Weights are relative; the chance of any event at all is 'chance' below.

events.name: Blood Moon
events.description: The horde doubles and comes in angry.

events.name: Solar Eclipse
events.description: Fewer things, but each one is a problem.

events.name: Frost Legion
events.description: The cold ones, and they are quick.

events.name: Pumpkin Moon
events.description: Everything is tougher, and everything pays.

events.name: Meteor Shower
events.description: Heads falling out of the sky, fast and fragile.
